svg.text: One policy enforcement point between AI agents and MCP tool servers. The agent token stops at the gateway; every upstream call carries its own 60-second token.
Local lab on Docker Compose · offline · no cloud account
300 s tokens · JWKS for the gateway
trusted boundary · single policy enforcement point
Python 3.12 · FastAPI · MCP Python SDK (streamable HTTP) · port 8080
MCP servers · outside the trust boundary
poisoned descriptions: visible, hidden tag, zero-width
rug pull: description changes after the pin
echoes the token it receives (passthrough probe)
audit trail · one span per decision
Token rule enforced at a stage
